problem_statement: When an IEEE 802.15.4 frame carries a legacy frame version (2003 or 2006) but has the Information Elements Present bit set in its Frame Control Field, the stack reports the IE-present bit as present, even though the standard defines that bit only for the 2015 frame version. As a result, legacy frames can be incorrectly treated as containing information elements. Required behavior: the IE-present bit in the Frame Control Field must be honored only for 802.15.4-2015 frame versions and must be ignored (reported as not present) for 2003 and 2006 frame versions, even when the underlying bit is set.
